dialogues.speaker: Venipi
dialogues.text: Having stood upon the line between life and death, I miss the flavor of beer most. Even my master and King Deshret himself would rank beneath it.

dialogues.speaker: Kshama
dialogues.text: Ah. I didn't know you so enjoyed your libations.

dialogues.speaker: Venipi
dialogues.text: When delivering bricks to the Mausoleum of King Deshret back in the day, we'd get two large mugs of beer for free every day.

dialogues.speaker: Venipi
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, was Maukie among those who were restored?

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvius
dialogues.text: No. I suspect the higher-ups intend to deal with him... in violation of the rules.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvius
dialogues.text: I wonder if the note I asked him to bring in secret came in handy.
